name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text:
**Decision:** The AI Executive Assistant (AE) should auto-publish a *time-only* alert to all teams when a Luma agent’s output exceeds the 30-minute mark.

**Why:** This single signal cuts cross-team friction by giving everyone a shared, actionable trigger—no chasing status updates. The trade-off is accepting false positives (e.g., complex tasks legitimately taking longer), but the clarity outweighs the noise.

name: Scriv
text: A time-only alert still leaks the exact moment of detection—attackers can infer system sensitivity and timing patterns. Instead, publish a *time-range* alert (e.g., "30-45 minutes") to obscure precision while keeping urgency. Settle this with a 48-hour test: run both versions in parallel and measure if the range alert reduces false positives without delaying responses.
